summary: Completed backend and mobile UI regression testing for GÖKBOSS POS. CRUD, products, reports, reconciliation, navigation, modal actions, exports, print action, and mobile overflow checks passed.
action_items: Consider filtering the frontend local report fallback by selected period; currently it aggregates all locally loaded sales and expenses when backend data is unavailable.
critical_code_review_comments: Frontend build emits a React Hook exhaustive-deps warning for loadReport; not a runtime failure but should be cleaned up.
seed_data_creation: Created and deleted one TEST_Rapor Ürünü product; existing demo fallback values were not modified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Desktop and mobile critical flows covered. Excel action was triggered, PDF action invoked window.print, and no runtime/error selectors or mobile horizontal overflow were found. Backend uses intentional demo/local fallback when MongoDB has no matching records.
rca of the issue: No blocking defects reproduced. The only observed quality item is the frontend fallback report aggregation: loadReport computes localReport from all loaded records regardless of daily/weekly/monthly selection, while the API endpoint correctly applies its period cutoff.
